overview_description.description: Estoca is a decentralized Fulfillment-as-a-Service for multi-channel businesses, allowing them to seamlessly deliver goods in less than 2 days in the main Brazilian cities, with hassle-free setup. We combine our network of warehouses with a prediction algorithm that allocates goods closer to customers.
